name: Lemon Slime
description:
Crafter's Guild is a one-of-a-kind Minecraft: Bedrock Edition server founded on a simple, powerful idea: what if the world was shaped by the creativity of its players? Here, our community members contribute their own custom-made addons, creating a server that is constantly growing, changing, and offering new adventures every single day.

◆ For Join

Hostname : play.lemon-slime.com

Port : 19132

◆ A Truly Diverse and Ever-Changing Gameplay Experience

Forget servers that lock you into one playstyle. In the Crafter's Guild, you'll find a massive collection of addons spanning every genre imaginable:

Economy & Trade: Build a commercial empire.

Railways: Design and operate complex transit systems.

Magic & Sorcery: Master arcane spells and abilities.

RPG & Adventure: Take on new quests and battle custom entities.

Quality of Life: Enjoy countless improvements to the core game.

Custom UI: Experience Minecraft with a fresh, player-designed interface.

With new addons being submitted and updated daily by our community, no two days are the same. Discover new items, face new challenges, and explore a world that is always expanding.

◆ Focus on Fun, Not Grinding

We believe your time is best spent on adventure and creation. That's why we've integrated features designed to eliminate tedious tasks:

Instant Tree & Ore Vein Mining: Cut down entire trees or mine whole ore veins with a single break.

Advanced Warping System: Instantly teleport to other players or pre-registered locations to travel the world with ease.

◆ A Player-Driven Economy

Become a market tycoon in our dynamic, player-driven economy. Our server features a full in-game currency system where you can buy and sell ores, crops, and other resources. Prices fluctuate based on real-time supply and demand generated by the entire community. To help new players get started, a Universal Basic Income is granted once per day.

◆ Are You a Creator? Or a Player? All Are Welcome!

For Developers & Creators: Join our Disc
